Good to know

Online MBA Frequently Asked Questions

Is an Online MBA valid for jobs and higher studies in India? +

Yes, provided the degree is offered by a university with active UGC-DEB entitlement for that academic session. Before applying, always confirm the university's current UGC-DEB status and programme recognition.

Who can apply for the Online MBA 2027–28 batch? +

Most UGC-entitled Online MBA programmes accept graduates from any recognised discipline (typically with 50% aggregate marks, or 45% for reserved categories). Executive or work-integrated programmes such as BITS Pilani WILP or XLRI Blended PGDM require prior full-time work experience.

What is the difference between an Online MBA, Distance (ODL) MBA, and Blended PGDM? +

An Online MBA is delivered primarily through live and recorded digital classes with online assessments. Distance (ODL) programmes combine self-study materials with periodic exam centres. Blended PGDM programmes combine live online sessions with mandatory short campus immersions.

Which universities are popular among students in Bihar, Jharkhand, Odisha and West Bengal? +

Working professionals and graduates across East India frequently choose national UGC-DEB universities such as NMIMS, Amity, Sikkim Manipal, Manipal Jaipur, Symbiosis, LPU, and JAIN Online, alongside regional institutions like KIIT Online, Utkal University, Sambalpur University, and XLRI Jamshedpur (Blended PGDM).

Are entrance exams like CAT or MAT mandatory for an Online MBA? +

Many UGC-entitled Online MBA programmes offer direct admission based on graduation eligibility without requiring CAT or MAT scores, though a few selective or executive programmes may conduct their own screening or interview.

How do I verify the exact fees and eligibility before paying? +

Fees listed on comparison pages are indicative and vary by specialisation, payment plan (annual vs semester), and scholarship batch. Always confirm the final fee schedule, exam charges, and eligibility directly with the university's official admission portal or through our counselling desk.

How does GB GROUP help with Online MBA admissions? +

GB GROUP provides free one-to-one career counselling to help you compare UGC-DEB entitled universities, shortlist the right specialisation, review eligibility documents, and complete your admission enquiry without hidden charges.
